metadata.title: Precision of The Chinese Space Station Telescope (CSST) Stellar Radial Velocities

notes: No eligible stars. The paper uses NGSL spectral templates to estimate CSST radial-velocity precision (T:p1-b4, T:p5-b2) and mentions hyper-velocity stars only as a possible science application (T:p1-b4, T:p11-b4); it does not identify any star as a Galactic unbound candidate or study any star because of prior unbound candidacy.
